tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a new Crosstalk group and return its ID. The creating context is the only context allowed to update its metadata or delete it. A name and description can be supplied as metadata.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

description.description: Optional description of the group's purpose.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List all groups and their metadata stored in the shared cache directory.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: get_group_metadata
tools.description: Return a group's name, description, and timestamps.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: update_group_metadata
tools.description: Update a group's name and/or description. Only the creating context may update metadata.

description.description: Optional description of the group's purpose.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.
Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Permanently delete a group's SQLite database and all of its message history. Only the creating context may delete it.

group_id.description: The group ID to permanently delete.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: join_group
tools.description: Join a group. A context must join before it can send, retrieve messages, or subscribe to wakeups.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: leave_group
tools.description: Leave a group and remove this context's wakeup subscription and pending wake events.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: get_all_messages
tools.description: Return the complete history of the supplied group.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: get_latest_messages
tools.description: Return messages after the supplied context_id's latest sent message. Before it has sent a message, returns the full history.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: get_unread_messages
tools.description: Return messages this context_id has not previously retrieved. All returned messages are marked as read by that context.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: get_messages_after
tools.description: Return messages with an ID after after_message_id and mark them read for this context.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

after_message_id.description: Return messages with IDs greater than this value.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Case-insensitively search message text in a group and mark matching messages read for this context. The query uses SQL LIKE wildcards: % matches any sequence and _ matches one character.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

query.description: Search pattern. SQL LIKE wildcards are supported: % matches any sequence and _ matches one character.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the supplied group as the supplied AI context. Use @context_id, @name, @all, or wake_context_ids for routing; otherwise every other joined context is targeted. Unknown wake_context_ids are ignored; if none are valid, normal routing is used.

context_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the calling AI context/session. Use your actual resumable context ID verbatim; for example, Codex exposes this in CODEX_THREAD_ID. Never invent an ID.

name.description: Human-readable caller label or role, used for logging (for example, 'architect').

wake_context_ids.description: Optional explicit context IDs to wake. Unknown IDs are ignored.

caller_name.description: Required human-readable caller name recorded in audit analytics.
